# Facilio

> Facilio is a Connected CMMS and property operations platform that leverages IoT and AI to optimize building maintenance, energy management, and portfolio operations for commercial real estate.

The platform serves property managers, facility teams, and real estate portfolios globally, with notable deployments in Australia and partnerships with organizations like Kingsmede, Investa, and Robert Dyas. Facilio enables automated workflows, real-time monitoring, and multi-stakeholder collaboration across building operations.

## Key Topics

- Connected CMMS
- Property Operations
- Facilities Management
- Portfolio Management
- Work Order Management
- Energy Management
- IoT Integration
- BMS Connectivity
- Workflow Automation
- Sustainability & Energy Efficiency
- Commercial Real Estate
- Tenant Experience
- Compliance & Inspection Management
- Preventive & Reactive Maintenance
- Real-time Monitoring

## Core Product Capabilities

- [Property Maintenance Management Software for Portfolios](https://facilio.com/product/property-maintenance-software): Property maintenance software for multi-property portfolio management
- [Facility Inspection Management Software for Automated Compliance](https://facilio.com/product/inspection-management-software): Facility inspection software with dynamic checklists & automated scheduling
- [Reactive Maintenance Software | Automate Workflows & Reduce Downtime](https://facilio.com/product/reactive-maintenance-software): Reactive maintenance software centralizing requests & automating workflows
